issues.description: In the template for Exercise 1 (ex1_grover_two_qubit_without_auxiliary_qubit.py) the attribute number_of_qubits_query_register is initialized to a float (0.0) and then passed to QuantumRegister(). QuantumRegister expects an integer number of qubits; using a float will cause a runtime/type error and prevents students from instantiating the circuit. The problem statement and the solution both expect a two-qubit query register for this exercise, so the template's float literal is an unintended structural/type error that will block students.
issues.suggested_fix:
Change the template attribute to an integer. Either use a placeholder integer (e.g. 0) or set it to the intended two qubits. For example:
self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 2
This ensures QuantumRegister(...) receives an integer and matches the problem description and solution.
